biggest_catch: You get nothing unless your referral completes the full Qualifying Activities: for a consumer checking account, that's 7+ debit card transactions (ATM excluded) within 30 days of account opening AND a $100+ ACH deposit within 60 days. A friend who opens but never transacts earns you zero.
catches: Consumer checking qualification: 7+ debit card transactions (ATM and cash withdrawals excluded) within 30 days of opening AND at least one $100+ ACH deposit within 60 days.
Business checking qualification: 10+ posted transactions and $2,000+ cumulative deposits within 60 days of opening.
Only one referrer is paid per referred individual; if multiple people refer the same person, only the first completed registration counts.
Maximum $500 in Rewards per calendar year per participant (as referrer, referred, or both); no partial rewards.
Rewards are virtual Visa Reward Cards delivered to the registered program email within 3 weeks of completing the Qualifying Activities; cards expire 6 months after issuance.
Rewards subject to IRS tax reporting; participants may be disqualified without a valid U.S. Taxpayer Identification Number (Form W-9).
Simmons Bank employees and household members are ineligible.
Disputes subject to binding arbitration (optional; can be rejected per the terms).
Promotional Period began January 22, 2024; program may be changed or cancelled at any time without notice.

steps: Register for the Simmons Bank Refer-A-Friend Program at simmonsbank.com/refer.
Refer friends/family by email (providing their contact info) or by sharing your unique referral link via social media or text (with the required disclosure).
Your referral registers via your link and opens a qualifying Simmons checking account within 90 days.
Your referral completes the Qualifying Activities (consumer: 7+ debit transactions in 30 days + $100+ ACH in 60 days; business: 10+ transactions + $2,000 deposits in 60 days).
You receive a $50 virtual Visa Reward Card per qualifying referral (within 3 weeks, up to $500/calendar year).
timing: Reward delivered to the registered program email address within 3 weeks after completion of the Qualifying Activities.
